answer: A payout is split and as a result 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The canyon schedule is applied in comet and vertex reveals each instalment. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4632 identities would post 2524 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
